game.title: Lord of the Rings: War in the North
game.blurb: Action RPG from Snowblind Studios (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive and Warner Bros. Interactive), published by Warner Bros. Interactive, released 2011-11-01. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story: Early Milestones
chapters.summary: Seven hidden story achievements with the higher unlock rates (76.5% down to 29.1%). Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Story: Later Milestones
chapters.summary: Nine hidden story achievements with lower unlock rates (26.4% down to 12.9%), through to the end of the story. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Normal, Heroic and Legendary
chapters.summary: Finishing a playthrough on Normal or higher, on Heroic and on Legendary.

chapters.title: Quests, Secrets and Treasure
chapters.summary: Quests, secrets, gilded treasure chests, coins, the wild snow trolls and the investigation of the Cult of the Lidless Eye.

chapters.title: Levels, Skills and Gear
chapters.summary: Character levels 10 and 20, skill tree ranks and unlocks, elfstones, armour sets and potions.

chapters.title: Allies, Beleram and Co-op
chapters.summary: Reviving allies, summoning Beleram, and slaying an enemy together with two other players.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Kill counts, critical hits, Hero Mode streaks, big melee and ranged strikes, headshots, war machines and absorbing damage.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4111). RAWG's store link points to Steam app 32800, which is not in the current store list; its schema ("ValveTestApp32800", a placeholder name) has the same 46 achievements as app 2523770 ("The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition"), the only matching app on sale, so the Legacy Edition was used (schema name "The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™"; its API names are just the numbers 1 to 46). StrategyWiki has "The Lord of the Rings: War in the North" at completion stage 0 (also in Category:Stubs); only Enemies (about 750 characters) and Table of Contents (about 800) are written. Gameplay, Controls, Eradan, Farin, Andriel, Walkthrough, Achievements and trophies and Quests are linked but not written, and the contents page lists no chapters. lotr.fandom.com answers the API under "The Lord of the Rings: War in the North" with about 76 linked articles (places such as Bree, Fornost, Rivendell, Mirkwood, Mount Gundabad and Carn Dûm, and characters); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 16 of 46 Steam achievements are hidden. The split of the hidden ones into early and late milestones by unlock rate is our own guess; "Eagle Savior" (12.9%) is the only hidden one before the others in the schema and sits in the later half. "Troll's Bane" (wild snow trolls) was put with quests and secrets as a guess.
